records.literal_gloss: For the director, of [the] sons of Korah, on alamoth. A song.

en.L: For the director: of the sons of Korah; on alamoth. A song.
en.B: For the music director. Of the sons of Korah. On alamoth. A song.
en.R: For the leader of the music. From the family of Korah. For high voices. A song.

fr.L: Au chef de chœur : des fils de Coré ; sur alamoth. Un cantique.
fr.B: Au chef de chœur. Des fils de Coré. Sur alamoth. Un cantique.
fr.R: Pour le chef des musiciens. De la famille de Coré. Pour voix aiguës. Un chant.

sw.L: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya: ya wana wa Kora; juu ya alamothi. Wimbo.
sw.B: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Ya wana wa Kora. Juu ya alamothi. Wimbo.
sw.R: Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji. Kutoka kwa ukoo wa Kora. Kwa sauti za juu. Wimbo.

es.L: Al director del coro: de los hijos de Coré; sobre alamot. Un cántico.
es.B: Al director del coro. De los hijos de Coré. Sobre alamot. Un cántico.
es.R: Para el director de la música. De la familia de Coré. Para voces agudas. Un canto.

vi.L: Cho người chỉ huy [ban nhạc]: của con cháu Cô-ra; theo [điệu] A-la-mốt. [Một] bài ca.
vi.B: Cho nhạc trưởng. Của con cháu Cô-ra. Theo điệu A-la-mốt. Bài ca.
vi.R: Cho người hướng dẫn ban nhạc. Của dòng họ Cô-ra. Cho giọng cao. Bài ca.

ko.L: 지휘자를 위하여. 고라 자손의 [노래]. 알라못에 맞추어. 노래.
ko.B: 음악 지휘자를 위하여. 고라 자손의 노래. 알라못에 맞추어. 노래.
ko.R: 찬양 인도자를 위해. 고라 자손이 지은 노래. 높은 음역으로 부르는 노래.

pt.L: Para o regente: dos filhos de Corá; sobre alamote. Cântico.
pt.B: Para o mestre de música. Dos filhos de Corá. Sobre alamote. Cântico.
pt.R: Para quem dirige a música. Da família de Corá. Para vozes agudas. Uma canção.

am.L: ለመዘምራን አለቃ፤ የቆሬ ልጆች፤ በዓላሞት። ቅኔ።
am.B: ለመዘምራን አለቃ። የቆሬ ልጆች። በዓላሞት። መዝሙር።
am.R: ለመዘምራን አለቃ። ከቆሬ ልጆች። ለቀጭን ድምፆች። መዝሙር።

hi.L: संगीत-निर्देशक के लिए: कोरह के पुत्रों का; अलामोत पर। गीत।
hi.B: संगीत-निर्देशक के लिए। कोरह के पुत्रों का। अलामोत पर। गीत।
hi.R: गायक-मंडली के अगुवे के लिए। कोरह के परिवार का। ऊँचे स्वरों के लिए। गीत।

ru.L: Руководителю хора: сыновей Корея; на аламот. Песнь.
ru.B: Руководителю хора. Сыновей Корея. На аламот. Песнь.
ru.R: Для руководителя музыкантов. Из семьи Корея. Для высоких голосов. Песня.

ja.L: 指揮する者のために。コラの子らによる。アラモトに合わせて。歌。
ja.B: 音楽を導く者のために。コラの子孫による。アラモトに合わせて。歌。
ja.R: 音楽を導く人のために。コラの一族による。高い声のために。歌。

uk.L: Для диригента: синів Корея; на аламот. Пісня.
uk.B: Для диригента хору. Синів Корея. На аламот. Пісня.
uk.R: Для того, хто керує співом. Від родини Корея. Для високих голосів. Пісня.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director: the one who leads the music
decisions.reason: As in 4:1, probably the leader of the temple music.

decisions.choice: the sons of Korah: a family of Levite singers
decisions.reason: The descendants of Korah, a Levite (Numbers 26:11), served as gatekeepers and singers at the temple (1 Chronicles 9:19; 2 Chronicles 20:19). Eleven psalms carry their name (42-49, 84-85, 87-88). "Of" may mean the psalm belongs to their collection or was written by one of them.

decisions.choice: alamoth: "young women", probably high voices
decisions.reason: The word ('alamot) is the plural of the word for a young woman. 1 Chronicles 15:20 has Levites playing harps "on alamoth", so it is a musical term, perhaps for high voices or instruments pitched high. Its exact sense is no longer known.

decisions.choice: song: a song for singing
decisions.reason: The word (shir) is the ordinary word for a song.

decisions.choice: for high voices
decisions.reason: Readable gives the likeliest sense of the term (m4).

decisions.choice: "juu ya alamothi" kept as a name at L and B; "kwa sauti za juu" (for high voices) at Readable
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means "young women" and probably names a high pitch for singing, but no one is sure. As in the English, Literal and Balanced keep the word, and Readable gives the likely sense.

decisions.choice: sobre alamot (L, B); Para voces agudas (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning of alamoth is not certain; it is the word for young women, and probably means high voices. Literal and Balanced keep it as a name, as the English does; Readable explains it as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "A-la-mốt" kept as a name (L, B); "Cho giọng cao" (R)
decisions.reason: The word means "young women" and probably names high voices, but this is not certain (see the meaning decision). Literal and Balanced keep it as a name; Readable gives the likely sense, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "알라못에 맞추어" (L, B), the Hebrew word kept as a name; Readable "높은 음역으로" (for high voices)
decisions.reason: The word means "young women" and probably names high voices (meaning decision m4, uncertain); Literal and Balanced keep it, Readable gives the likely sense as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: alamote
decisions.reason: The musical term is spelled as in the Portuguese of 1 Chronicles 15:20, where Levites play harps on it, and kept as a word at Literal and Balanced since its sense is unknown (m4); Readable says "para vozes agudas", as 1 Chronicles 15:20 and the English Readable do.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; the Amharic text has no deity_pronoun spans.

decisions.choice: alamoth as "በዓላሞት" (Literal, Balanced), "ለቀጭን ድምፆች" (Readable), as 1 Chronicles 15:20 on main
decisions.reason: The musical term is the one in 1 Chronicles 15:20, so the Amharic keeps the forms used there.

decisions.choice: अलामोत पर (L, B); ऊँचे स्वरों के लिए (R)
decisions.reason: Alamoth means "young women" and is probably a direction for high voices; its meaning is not certain. Literal and Balanced keep it as a name, अलामोत, and Readable gives the likeliest sense, as the English does. The Korah title is as in 42:1.

decisions.choice: "Руководителю хора"; "сыновей Корея" (L, B), "из семьи Корея" (R)
decisions.reason: The title words have one form through the Korah psalms (42-49) as the poetry note gives them: "Руководителю хора" (L, B), "Для руководителя музыкантов" (R); "маскиль" kept as a term at Literal and Balanced, "песня, чтобы учить" at Readable; and "сыновей Корея" (L, B), "из семьи Корея" (R), with Korah in the form of Numbers 16 (Корей). This title uses them as in 42:1.

decisions.choice: "на аламот" (L, B); "Для высоких голосов" (R)
decisions.reason: Alamoth means "young women" and probably points to high voices (m4); Literal and Balanced keep the term as the poetry note does, Readable gives the likely sense, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Песнь" (L, B); "Песня" (R)
decisions.reason: The poetry note's forms for shir, "a song".

decisions.choice: 'al-'alamot "アラモトに合わせて" (L, B), "高い声のために" (R); shir "歌" every level
decisions.reason: The Psalter's title terms (PSA-1, from 1 Chronicles 15:20); probably high voices (m4, uncertain).

source.text: אֱלֹהִ֣ים לָ֭נוּ מַחֲסֶ֣ה וָעֹ֑ז עֶזְרָ֥ה בְ֝צָר֗וֹת נִמְצָ֥א מְאֹֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: God [is] for us a refuge and strength, a help in troubles, found exceedingly.

en.L: God [is] for us a refuge and strength, a help in troubles [that is] found exceedingly.
en.B: God is a shelter and a strength for us, a help always close at hand in times of distress.
en.R: God keeps us safe and makes us strong. When trouble comes, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is always there to help.

fr.L: Dieu [est] pour nous un refuge et une force, un secours dans les détresses, [qui se laisse] trouver pleinement.
fr.B: Dieu est pour nous un abri et une force, un secours toujours tout proche dans la détresse.
fr.R: Dieu nous garde en sécurité et nous rend forts. Quand le malheur arrive, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est toujours là pour nous aider.

sw.L: Mungu [ni] kwetu kimbilio na nguvu, msaada katika taabu [anayeonekana] mno.
sw.B: Mungu ni kimbilio na nguvu yetu, msaada ulio karibu sana wakati wa shida.
sw.R: Mungu hutulinda na kutupa nguvu. Shida zinapokuja, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} yuko pale daima kutusaidia.

es.L: Dios [es] para nosotros refugio y fuerza, ayuda en las angustias [que se] encuentra muy cerca.
es.B: Dios es para nosotros un amparo y una fuerza, una ayuda siempre a mano en tiempos de angustia.
es.R: Dios nos protege y nos hace fuertes. Cuando vienen los problemas, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} siempre está ahí para ayudarnos.

vi.L: Đức Chúa Trời [là] nơi ẩn náu và sức mạnh cho chúng ta, một sự giúp đỡ trong những cơn hoạn nạn [mà] được tìm thấy rất [gần].
vi.B: Đức Chúa Trời là nơi ẩn náu và sức mạnh của chúng ta, là Đấng giúp đỡ luôn ở gần trong lúc gian nan.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời giữ chúng ta an toàn và làm cho chúng ta mạnh mẽ. Khi hoạn nạn đến, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} luôn ở đó để giúp đỡ.

ko.L: 하나님은 우리에게 피난처와 힘, 고난 중에 아주 가까이 계시는 도움[이시다].
ko.B: 하나님은 우리의 피난처이시요 힘이시며, 고난 속에서 언제나 곁에 계시는 도움이시다.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 우리를 안전하게 지키시고 힘을 주신다. 어려운 일이 닥칠 때 언제나 우리를 도와주신다.

pt.L: Deus [é] para nós abrigo e força, socorro nas angústias [que] se deixa achar plenamente.
pt.B: Deus é abrigo e força para nós, uma ajuda sempre à mão nos tempos de aflição.
pt.R: Deus nos protege e nos dá força. Quando vêm os problemas, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} está sempre ali para ajudar.

am.L: እግዚአብሔር ለእኛ መጠጊያና ብርታት [ነው]፤ በመከራ ጊዜ እጅግ ቅርብ ሆኖ የሚገኝ ረዳት [ነው]።
am.B: እግዚአብሔር ለእኛ መጠጊያና ብርታት ነው፤ በጭንቀት ጊዜ ሁልጊዜ በአጠገባችን ያለ ረዳት ነው።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር በደኅና ይጠብቀናል፤ ብርቱዎችም ያደርገናል። መከራ ሲመጣ ሊረዳን ሁልጊዜ በአጠገባችን ነው።

hi.L: परमेश्वर हमारे लिए शरणस्थान और बल [हैं], संकटों में एक सहायक [जो] बहुत ही निकट पाए गए [हैं]।
hi.B: परमेश्वर हमारे शरणस्थान और हमारा बल हैं, संकट के समय में सदा पास रहनेवाले सहायक।
hi.R: परमेश्वर हमें सुरक्षित रखते हैं और हमें बलवान बनाते हैं। जब संकट आता है, तब वे सहायता करने के लिए सदा वहाँ होते हैं।

ru.L: Бог для нас — прибежище и сила, помощь в бедах, [которая] оказывается весьма [близкой].
ru.B: Бог — наше прибежище и сила, помощь, которая всегда рядом во время бедствий.
ru.R: Бог хранит нас и делает нас сильными. Когда приходит беда, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} всегда рядом, чтобы помочь.

ja.L: 神は、わたしたちにとって避け所、また力。苦難のうちに、確かに見いだされる助け。
ja.B: 神は、わたしたちの避け所、わたしたちの力。苦しみの時には、いつもすぐそばにいて、助けとなってくださる。
ja.R: 神は、わたしたちを守り、強くしてくださる。困ったことが起きるとき、その方はいつもそこにいて、助けてくださる。

uk.L: Бог для нас — притулок і сила, допомога в бідах, що знаходиться вельми.
uk.B: Бог — наше сховище й наша сила, допомога, що завжди поруч у часи скрути.
uk.R: Бог береже нас і робить нас сильними. Коли приходить біда, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} завжди поруч, щоб допомогти.

decisions.choice: refuge: a shelter to run to
decisions.reason: The word (machaseh) is a place of shelter from storm or danger, from the verb "take refuge" (2:12; 14:6).

decisions.choice: found exceedingly: he proves to be very near
alternatives: he has been found to be a great help
decisions.reason: The verb (nimtsa') means "is found" or "is present". With "exceedingly" it says that God is readily found, or that he has proved himself fully, when trouble comes.

decisions.choice: a song of Zion
decisions.reason: Psalms 46, 48, 76 and 87 celebrate Zion, Jerusalem, as the city where God lives and which he defends. The psalm moves from the shaking of the world (verses 3-4) to the city (5-6) and to the end of war (9-11), with a refrain at verses 8 and 12.

decisions.choice: always close at hand (B); always there to help (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "found exceedingly" means (m2).

decisions.choice: "được tìm thấy rất [gần]"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says he is "found exceedingly", that is, he proves very near (see the meaning decision); Vietnamese needs the bracketed "gần" (near) to say it.

decisions.choice: The singers speak about God in the plain written style with the honorific (계시는, 이시다), and of themselves as "우리"; no deity_pronoun spans (Hangul has no capitals)
decisions.reason: Style guide section 7a: the psalmist speaks about God in the plain written style with -시-; respect is carried by the honorific, so the English pronoun setting has nothing to change in Korean.

decisions.choice: "피난처" (refuge) at Literal and Balanced; Readable says it as a verb, "안전하게 지키시고"
decisions.reason: As the terms note; Readable puts the picture of a shelter into plain words, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: abrigo e força; se deixa achar plenamente (L), sempre à mão (B)
decisions.reason: Drafted from the Hebrew: "abrigo" is a shelter one runs to (m1), and the last words say that God is readily found in trouble (m2). The familiar Portuguese wording of this famous verse is avoided on purpose; the meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
alternatives: capitalised pronoun spans, as in English
decisions.reason: Hindi has no capital letters; God is set apart by तू in address and honorific forms (वे, उनका) in the third person, so the Hindi has no deity_pronoun spans in this psalm.

decisions.choice: "прибежище" for "refuge"
decisions.reason: The poetry note's word for God as a shelter to run to (m1).

decisions.choice: machaseh "避け所" (L, B); nimtsa me'od "確かに見いだされる" (L), "いつもすぐそばにいて" (B), "いつもそこにいて" (R)
decisions.reason: The Psalter's refuge words (PSA-1); "found exceedingly" is read as proving very near (m2). Worded afresh, apart from the familiar church renderings of this verse.

source.text: עַל־כֵּ֣ן לֹא־נִ֭ירָא בְּהָמִ֣יר אָ֑רֶץ וּבְמ֥וֹט הָ֝רִ֗ים בְּלֵ֣ב יַמִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore not we will fear when [the] earth changes and when mountains totter in [the] heart of [the] seas,

en.L: Therefore we will not fear when [the] earth changes, and when [the] mountains totter into the heart of the seas,
en.B: So we will not be afraid, even if the earth is overturned and the mountains slide down into the depths of the sea,
en.R: So we will not be afraid, even if the earth shakes apart and the mountains fall into the middle of the sea.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi nous ne craindrons pas quand la terre change de place, et quand les montagnes chancellent au cœur des mers,
fr.B: Aussi nous n’aurons pas peur, même si la terre est bouleversée et si les montagnes glissent au fond de la mer,
fr.R: Alors nous n’aurons pas peur, même si la terre tremble et se brise, et si les montagnes tombent au milieu de la mer.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo hatutaogopa dunia ibadilikapo, na milima iyumbayumbapo katika moyo wa bahari,
sw.B: Kwa hiyo hatutaogopa, hata dunia ikipinduka na milima ikiporomoka kuingia vilindini mwa bahari,
sw.R: Kwa hiyo hatutaogopa, hata kama dunia itatikisika na kupasuka, na milima ikaanguka katikati ya bahari.

es.L: Por eso no temeremos cuando [la] tierra se trastorne, y cuando [los] montes se tambaleen hacia el corazón de los mares,
es.B: Por eso no tendremos miedo, aunque la tierra se derrumbe y los montes se deslicen hasta lo profundo del mar,
es.R: Por eso no tendremos miedo, aunque la tierra se parta en pedazos y los montes caigan en medio del mar.

vi.L: Vì vậy chúng ta sẽ không sợ khi đất thay đổi, và khi núi non lung lay vào lòng biển cả,
vi.B: Vì thế chúng ta sẽ không sợ hãi, dù đất bị đảo lộn và núi non trượt xuống đáy biển sâu,
vi.R: Vì vậy chúng ta sẽ không sợ, dù đất có rung chuyển tan tành và núi non đổ sụp xuống giữa lòng biển.

ko.L: 그러므로 우리는 두려워하지 않는다, 땅이 변하고 산들이 바다 한가운데로 흔들려 [빠질] 때에도.
ko.B: 그러므로 땅이 뒤집히고 산들이 바다 깊은 곳으로 미끄러져 내려간다 해도 우리는 두려워하지 않는다.
ko.R: 그러니 땅이 흔들려 갈라지고 산들이 바닷속으로 무너져 내린다 해도 우리는 무서워하지 않는다.

pt.L: Por isso não teremos medo quando [a] terra mudar de lugar, e quando [os] montes cambalearem para dentro do coração dos mares,
pt.B: Assim, não vamos ter medo, mesmo que a terra seja revirada e as montanhas deslizem para o fundo do mar,
pt.R: Por isso não teremos medo, mesmo que a terra se parta ao meio e as montanhas caiam no meio do mar.

am.L: ስለዚህ ምድር ብትለወጥ፣ ተራሮችም ወደ ባሕሮች ልብ ቢናወጡ አንፈራም፤
am.B: ስለዚህ ምድር ብትገለበጥ፣ ተራሮችም ተንሸራትተው ወደ ጥልቁ ባሕር ቢገቡ እንኳ አንፈራም፤
am.R: ስለዚህ ምድር ብትናወጥና ብትፈራርስ፣ ተራሮችም ወደ ባሕር መካከል ቢወድቁ እንኳ አንፈራም።

hi.L: इसलिए हम नहीं डरेंगे, चाहे पृथ्वी बदल जाए, और चाहे पहाड़ डगमगाकर समुद्रों के बीच में जा पड़ें,
hi.B: इसलिए हम नहीं डरेंगे, चाहे पृथ्वी उलट जाए और पहाड़ खिसककर समुद्र की गहराइयों में जा गिरें,
hi.R: इसलिए हम नहीं डरेंगे, चाहे पृथ्वी हिलकर टुकड़े-टुकड़े हो जाए और पहाड़ समुद्र के बीच में गिर पड़ें।

ru.L: Поэтому не будем бояться, когда изменится земля и когда пошатнутся горы в сердце морей,
ru.B: Поэтому мы не будем бояться, даже если земля перевернётся и горы сползут в морскую глубину,
ru.R: Поэтому мы не будем бояться, даже если земля расколется и горы упадут в середину моря.

ja.L: それゆえ、わたしたちは恐れない、地が変わり、山々が海の心へとよろめいても、
ja.B: だから、わたしたちは恐れない。たとえ地がくつがえり、山々が海の深みへ崩れ落ちても、
ja.R: だから、わたしたちは恐れない。たとえ大地が揺れて裂け、山々が海の真ん中に崩れ落ちても。

uk.L: Тому ми не боятимемося, коли земля зміниться і коли гори захитаються в серце морів,
uk.B: Тож ми не боятимемося, навіть якщо земля перевернеться, а гори сповзуть у глибини моря,
uk.R: Тож ми не боятимемося, навіть якщо земля розколеться, а гори впадуть посеред моря.

decisions.choice: mountains into the heart of the seas: the world coming undone
decisions.reason: The mountains were pictured as the pillars of the world, set in the deep (Jonah 2). For them to slide into the sea is creation returning to chaos. Even then the people who have God as refuge will not fear.

decisions.choice: changes: is overturned
decisions.reason: The verb (mur, here causative) means to change or exchange; for the earth it means being thrown out of its place.

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: The "when" clauses continue into verse 4, so this verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: 46:3 ends with 、 and 46:4 finishes the "even if" clause (L, B), as the English
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sentence runs on (m3); Japanese keeps each half after its own verse number. The world coming undone (m1).

source.text: יֶהֱמ֣וּ יֶחְמְר֣וּ מֵימָ֑יו יִֽרְעֲשֽׁוּ־הָרִ֖ים בְּגַאֲוָת֣וֹ סֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: Its waters roar, they foam; mountains quake at its swelling. Selah.

en.L: [when] its waters roar [and] foam, [and] mountains quake at its swelling. Selah
en.B: when its waters roar and churn and the mountains shudder as the sea heaves. Selah
en.R: The sea may roar and foam. Its huge waves may make the mountains shake. Selah

fr.L: [quand] ses eaux grondent [et] écument, [et que] les montagnes tremblent à son soulèvement. Sélah
fr.B: quand ses eaux mugissent et bouillonnent, et que les montagnes frémissent sous la houle. Sélah
fr.R: La mer peut gronder et écumer. Ses énormes vagues peuvent faire trembler les montagnes. Sélah

sw.L: [wakati] maji yake yanavuma [na] kutoa povu, [na] milima inatetemeka kwa kujivuna kwake. Sela
sw.B: maji yake yanapovuma na kuchafuka, na milima inapotetemeka bahari inapojaa. Sela
sw.R: Bahari inaweza kunguruma na kutoa povu. Mawimbi yake makubwa yanaweza kutikisa milima. Sela

es.L: [cuando] sus aguas rujan [y] se encrespen, [y] los montes tiemblen ante su crecida. Selah
es.B: cuando sus aguas rugen y se agitan, y los montes se estremecen al levantarse el mar. Selah
es.R: Puede rugir el mar y llenarse de espuma. Sus grandes olas pueden hacer temblar los montes. Selah

vi.L: [khi] nước biển gầm thét [và] sủi bọt, [và] núi non rung chuyển vì sóng dâng lên. Sê-la
vi.B: khi nước biển gầm thét và cuộn sôi, và núi non run rẩy vì biển dâng trào. Sê-la
vi.R: Biển có thể gầm thét và sủi bọt. Những con sóng lớn có thể làm núi non rung chuyển. Sê-la

ko.L: 그 물이 으르렁거리며 거품을 일으키고, 그 넘실거림에 산들이 떨 [때에도]. 셀라.
ko.B: 바닷물이 으르렁거리며 소용돌이치고 바다가 솟구쳐 산들이 떨 때에도. 셀라.
ko.R: 바다가 으르렁거리며 거품을 일으킬 수도 있다. 큰 파도가 산들을 흔들 수도 있다. 셀라.

pt.L: [quando] as suas águas rugirem [e] espumarem, [e] os montes tremerem com a sua altivez. Selá
pt.B: quando as suas águas rugem e se agitam, e os montes estremecem quando o mar se levanta. Selá
pt.R: O mar pode rugir e espumar. As suas ondas enormes podem fazer as montanhas tremerem. Selá

am.L: ውኆቹ ቢያስገመግሙና አረፋ ቢደፍቁ፣ ከሞገዱም መነሣት የተነሣ ተራሮች ቢንቀጠቀጡ። ሴላ
am.B: ውኆቹ ቢያስገመግሙና ቢናወጡ፣ ባሕሩ ሲነሣ ተራሮች ቢንቀጠቀጡ። ሴላ
am.R: ባሕሩ ሊያስገመግምና አረፋ ሊደፍቅ ይችላል። ታላላቅ ማዕበሎቹ ተራሮችን ያንቀጠቅጡ ይሆናል። ሴላ

hi.L: [चाहे] उसका जल गरजे [और] फेन उठाए, [और] उसके उफान से पहाड़ काँप उठें। सेला
hi.B: चाहे उसका जल गरजे और उफने, और समुद्र के उमड़ने से पहाड़ थरथरा उठें। सेला
hi.R: समुद्र चाहे गरजे और फेन उठाए। उसकी बड़ी-बड़ी लहरें चाहे पहाड़ों को हिला दें। सेला

ru.L: [когда] шумят [и] пенятся воды его, [и] дрожат горы от вздымания его. Села
ru.B: когда его воды ревут и бурлят и горы содрогаются, когда вздымается море. Села
ru.R: Пусть море ревёт и пенится. Пусть его огромные волны сотрясают горы. Села

ja.L: その水が騒ぎ、泡立ち、その高ぶりに山々が震えても。セラ
ja.B: その水がとどろき、逆巻き、海の高まりに山々が揺れ動いても。セラ
ja.R: 海はとどろき、泡立つかもしれない。その大波で、山々が揺れるかもしれない。セラ

uk.L: [коли] ревуть [і] пінуться його води, [і] тремтять гори від його здіймання. Села
uk.B: коли його води ревуть і вирують, а гори здригаються, як море здіймається. Села
uk.R: Море може ревіти й пінитися. Його величезні хвилі можуть трясти горами. Села

decisions.choice: its: the sea's
decisions.reason: "Its" refers back to "the seas" of verse 3, the sea as one body of water.

decisions.choice: swelling: the surging, proud rise of the sea
decisions.reason: The word (ga'avah) means rising up, and so pride. The sea is pictured as rising up in arrogance (Job 38:11), but it cannot shake the city of God (verses 5-6).

decisions.choice: roar: be in uproar
decisions.reason: The same verb (hamah) is used of the nations in verse 7: the raging sea is a picture of the raging nations.

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

decisions.choice: "Sélah", kept as it is at the end of the verse at every level, for this block of psalms
decisions.reason: No one now knows what the word means; it is probably a direction for the singers or musicians (see the meaning decision on Selah). French keeps the word in its usual French spelling rather than guess at a translation.

decisions.choice: "Sela" kept at the end of the verse at every level, for Psalms 45-68
decisions.reason: Nobody now knows what the Hebrew word means; it is probably a direction for the music or the singers. Swahili keeps it as a word, as the English keeps "Selah", in the form long used in Swahili.

decisions.choice: Selah
decisions.reason: Selah is a Hebrew word whose meaning is no longer known; it is probably a direction for the music. It is kept as it is, at the end of its verse, at every level, as the English keeps it.

decisions.choice: "Sê-la" kept at the end of the verse at every level
decisions.reason: No one now knows what the word means; it is probably a musical direction (see the meaning decision). Vietnamese keeps it as a name, as the English keeps "Selah".

decisions.choice: "셀라" kept as a word at the end of the verse, at every level
decisions.reason: Selah is a word whose meaning is no longer known, probably a musical direction such as a pause or a rise (meaning decision); Korean keeps the Hebrew word, as the English keeps "Selah", in this and the following psalms.

decisions.choice: Verse 4 ends with "때에도" (even when), continuing the sentence begun in verse 3
decisions.reason: The Hebrew runs on from verse 3 (its meaning decision m3); Korean finishes verse 3's main clause first and lets verse 4 add a further "even when" so that each verse keeps its own content.

decisions.choice: a sua altivez
decisions.reason: The word is the sea's rising and also its pride (m2); "altivez", height carried proudly, keeps both at Literal. Balanced says what happens, "quando o mar se levanta", as the English Balanced does.

decisions.choice: ga'avah "その高ぶり" (L), "海の高まり" (B), "大波" (R); Selah "セラ"
decisions.reason: The surging, proud rise of the sea (m2); Selah as PSA-1 (m4, uncertain).

source.text: נָהָ֗ר פְּלָגָ֗יו יְשַׂמְּח֥וּ עִיר־אֱלֹהִ֑ים קְ֝דֹ֗שׁ מִשְׁכְּנֵ֥י עֶלְיֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: A river — its streams make glad [the] city of God, [the] holy [place] of [the] dwellings of [the] Most High.

en.L: A river — its streams make glad the city of God, the holy [place] of the dwellings of the Most High.
en.B: There is a river; its channels bring joy to God's city, the sacred home of the Most High.
en.R: A river flows with streams that make God's city happy. It is the holy place where the God who is above all lives.

fr.L: Un fleuve — ses canaux réjouissent la ville de Dieu, le saint [lieu] des demeures du Très-Haut.
fr.B: Il est un fleuve dont les bras réjouissent la ville de Dieu, la sainte demeure du Très-Haut.
fr.R: Un fleuve coule, et ses bras rendent heureuse la ville de Dieu. C’est le lieu saint où habite le Dieu qui est au-dessus de tout.

sw.L: Mto — vijito vyake vinaufurahisha mji wa Mungu, mahali patakatifu pa makao ya Aliye Juu Kabisa.
sw.B: Kuna mto; mifereji yake inauletea furaha mji wa Mungu, makao matakatifu ya Aliye Juu Kabisa.
sw.R: Mto unatiririka na vijito vinavyoufurahisha mji wa Mungu. Ni mahali patakatifu anapoishi Mungu aliye juu ya vyote.

es.L: Un río —sus corrientes alegran la ciudad de Dios, el [lugar] santo de las moradas del Altísimo.
es.B: Hay un río cuyos canales llenan de alegría la ciudad de Dios, la santa morada del Altísimo.
es.R: Un río corre con arroyos que alegran la ciudad de Dios. Es el lugar santo donde vive el Dios que está por encima de todo.

vi.L: [Có] một dòng sông — các dòng nước của nó làm vui thành của Đức Chúa Trời, nơi thánh của các nơi ngự của Đấng Chí Cao.
vi.B: Có một dòng sông; các nhánh sông làm vui mừng thành của Đức Chúa Trời, là nơi ở thánh của Đấng Chí Cao.
vi.R: Có một dòng sông chảy ra nhiều dòng suối, làm cho thành của Đức Chúa Trời vui vẻ. Đó là nơi thánh, nơi Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng cao hơn mọi sự, ngự.

ko.L: 강이 있어 — 그 물줄기들이 하나님의 성을 기쁘게 한다, 지극히 높으신 분이 거하시는 곳들의 거룩한 [곳을].
ko.B: 한 강이 있어, 그 물줄기들이 하나님의 성을 기쁘게 한다. 그곳은 지극히 높으신 분이 계시는 거룩한 곳이다.
ko.R: 강이 흐르고 그 물줄기들이 하나님의 성을 기쁘게 한다. 그곳은 모든 것 위에 계신 하나님께서 사시는 거룩한 곳이다.

pt.L: Um rio — os seus canais alegram a cidade de Deus, o [lugar] santo das moradas do Altíssimo.
pt.B: Existe um rio cujos braços enchem de alegria a cidade de Deus, a morada santa do Altíssimo.
pt.R: Um rio corre com riachos que deixam alegre a cidade de Deus. Ali é o lugar santo onde mora o Deus que está acima de tudo.

am.L: ወንዝ — ፈሳሾቹ የእግዚአብሔርን ከተማ፣ የልዑልን ማደሪያዎች ቅዱስ [ስፍራ] ደስ ያሰኛሉ።
am.B: አንድ ወንዝ አለ፤ ጅረቶቹ የእግዚአብሔርን ከተማ፣ የልዑልን ቅዱስ መኖሪያ ደስ ያሰኛሉ።
am.R: አንድ ወንዝ ይፈስሳል፤ ጅረቶቹም የእግዚአብሔርን ከተማ ደስ ያሰኛሉ። እርሷ ከሁሉ በላይ የሆነው አምላክ የሚኖርባት ቅዱስ ስፍራ ናት።

hi.L: एक नदी [है] — उसकी धाराएँ परमेश्वर की नगरी को आनंदित करती हैं, परमप्रधान के निवासस्थानों के पवित्र [स्थान] को।
hi.B: एक नदी है जिसकी नहरें परमेश्वर के नगर को, परमप्रधान के पवित्र निवास को, आनंद से भर देती हैं।
hi.R: एक नदी बहती है, जिसकी धाराएँ परमेश्वर के नगर को आनंदित करती हैं। यह वह पवित्र स्थान है जहाँ वे परमेश्वर रहते हैं जो सबसे ऊपर हैं।

ru.L: Река — потоки её веселят город Божий, святое [место] жилищ Всевышнего.
ru.B: Есть река, чьи протоки радуют Божий город, святую обитель Всевышнего.
ru.R: Течёт река, и её ручьи радуют Божий город. Это святое место, где живёт Бог, который выше всех.

ja.L: 川がある――その流れは神の都を喜ばせる、いと高き方の住まいの聖なる所を。
ja.B: 一つの川がある。その流れは神の都を喜ばせる。いと高き方の聖なる住まいを。
ja.R: 一本の川が流れ、その流れが神の都を喜ばせる。そこは、すべてのものの上におられる神が住まわれる、聖なる所だ。

uk.L: Ріка — її потоки веселять місто Боже, святе [місце] осель Всевишнього.
uk.B: Є ріка; її рукави приносять радість Божому місту, святій оселі Всевишнього.
uk.R: Ріка тече потоками, що радують Боже місто. Це святе місце, де живе Бог, який вищий за все.

decisions.choice: a river: the life that flows from God's presence
decisions.reason: Jerusalem has no river, only the spring of Gihon. The river is a picture of the life and peace that flow from God's dwelling, like the river of Eden (Genesis 2:10) and the river from the temple in Ezekiel 47:1-12. It stands against the raging waters of verses 3-4.

decisions.choice: the dwellings: God's dwelling place
alternatives: the Most High has made his dwelling holy (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The plural (mishkenot) is often used for a single dwelling, as for the tabernacle (43:3). The ancient Greek translation reads the words differently, "the Most High has made his dwelling holy".

decisions.choice: the Most High: God above all
decisions.reason: The title ('Elyon) names God as the highest over all (Genesis 14:19; 7:18).

decisions.choice: the God who is above all
decisions.reason: Readable says what the title means (m3).

decisions.choice: "Aliye Juu Kabisa" for the Most High (L, B); "Mungu aliye juu ya vyote" at Readable, as the English Readable explains it
decisions.reason: This follows "Mungu Aliye Juu Kabisa" for El Elyon in the Pentateuch; where the Hebrew has the title alone, the phrase stands as a name with its capitals.

decisions.choice: "Đấng Chí Cao" (L, B); "Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng cao hơn mọi sự" (R)
decisions.reason: "Đấng Chí Cao" is the title for God Most High used elsewhere in this translation; Readable explains it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "지극히 높으신 분" (L, B) and "모든 것 위에 계신 하나님" (R) for the Most High
decisions.reason: The title says God above all (meaning decision m2); "지존자" is an older Sino-Korean word; Readable explains as the English Readable does. This holds through these psalms.

decisions.choice: the Most High ('Elyon) as "ልዑል" (Literal, Balanced); Readable "ከሁሉ በላይ የሆነው አምላክ", as the English
decisions.reason: "ልዑል" is the Amharic Bible's title for God Most High (El Elyon "ልዑል አምላክ" in Genesis 14); Readable explains it.

decisions.choice: परमप्रधान (L, B); वे परमेश्वर ... जो सबसे ऊपर हैं (R)
decisions.reason: Elyon, the Most High, is परमप्रधान, as in Hebrews 7:1; Readable says what the title means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Всевышний" (L, B); "Бог, который выше всех" (R)
decisions.reason: The poetry note's word for Elyon at Literal and Balanced; Readable says what the title means (m3), as the English does.

decisions.choice: 'Elyon "いと高き方" (L, B), "すべてのものの上におられる神" (R); mishkenei "住まい"
decisions.reason: The Psalter's form for Elyon (PSA-1); God's dwelling place (m2, uncertain).

source.text: אֱלֹהִ֣ים בְּ֭קִרְבָּהּ בַּל־תִּמּ֑וֹט יַעְזְרֶ֥הָ אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לִפְנ֥וֹת בֹּֽקֶר׃

records.literal_gloss: God [is] in her midst; not she will be shaken; God will help her at [the] turning of morning.

en.L: God [is] in her midst; she will not be shaken; God will help her at the turning of [the] morning.
en.B: God is in the middle of the city; nothing will topple it. God will come to its aid as the morning breaks.
en.R: God is right there in the city, so nothing can knock it down. He will help it as soon as morning comes.

fr.L: Dieu [est] en son milieu ; elle ne sera pas ébranlée ; Dieu la secourra au tournant du matin.
fr.B: Dieu est au milieu de la ville : rien ne la renversera. Dieu viendra à son secours dès le point du jour.
fr.R: Dieu est là, dans la ville, alors rien ne peut la faire tomber. Il l’aidera dès que le matin arrivera.

sw.L: Mungu [yuko] katikati yake; hautatikisika; Mungu atausaidia asubuhi inapopambazuka.
sw.B: Mungu yuko katikati ya mji; hakuna kitakachouangusha. Mungu atausaidia kunapopambazuka.
sw.R: Mungu yuko pale pale mjini, kwa hiyo hakuna kinachoweza kuuangusha. Atausaidia mara asubuhi inapofika.

es.L: Dios [está] en medio de ella; no será sacudida; Dios la ayudará al despuntar la mañana.
es.B: Dios está en medio de la ciudad; nada la derribará. Dios vendrá en su ayuda al romper el alba.
es.R: Dios está allí mismo, en la ciudad, y nada la puede derribar. Él la ayudará en cuanto llegue la mañana.

vi.L: Đức Chúa Trời [ở] giữa thành; thành sẽ không bị lay chuyển; Đức Chúa Trời sẽ giúp đỡ thành lúc rạng đông.
vi.B: Đức Chúa Trời ở giữa thành; không gì lật đổ được thành. Đức Chúa Trời sẽ đến cứu giúp thành khi trời vừa sáng.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời ở ngay trong thành, nên không gì có thể làm thành sụp đổ. Ngài sẽ giúp đỡ thành ngay khi trời sáng.

ko.L: 하나님이 그 가운데 [계시니] 그 성은 흔들리지 않을 것이다. 아침이 바뀔 때 하나님이 그 성을 도우실 것이다.
ko.B: 하나님께서 그 성 한가운데 계시니 아무것도 그 성을 무너뜨리지 못한다. 동틀 무렵에 하나님께서 그 성을 도우신다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 바로 그 성 안에 계시니 그 무엇도 그 성을 쓰러뜨릴 수 없다. 아침이 밝자마자 하나님께서 그 성을 도우신다.

pt.L: Deus [está] no meio dela; ela não vacilará; Deus a socorrerá na virada da manhã.
pt.B: Deus está no meio da cidade; nada vai derrubá-la. Deus virá socorrê-la quando a manhã raiar.
pt.R: Deus está ali mesmo, na cidade, e por isso nada consegue derrubá-la. Ele vai ajudá-la logo que a manhã chegar.

am.L: እግዚአብሔር በመካከሏ [ነው]፤ አትናወጥም፤ እግዚአብሔር በንጋት መባቻ ይረዳታል።
am.B: እግዚአብሔር በከተማዪቱ መካከል ነው፤ ምንም አይጥላትም። ጎሕ ሲቀድ እግዚአብሔር ይረዳታል።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር በከተማዪቱ ውስጥ ነው፤ ስለዚህ ምንም ሊያፈርሳት አይችልም። ጠዋት እንደ ገባ ይረዳታል።

hi.L: परमेश्वर उसके बीच में [हैं]; वह नहीं डगमगाएगी; परमेश्वर भोर होते ही उसकी सहायता करेंगे।
hi.B: परमेश्वर उस नगर के बीच में हैं; कोई उसे गिरा न सकेगा। पौ फटते ही परमेश्वर उसकी सहायता करेंगे।
hi.R: परमेश्वर ठीक उसी नगर में हैं, इसलिए कोई उसे गिरा नहीं सकता। सुबह होते ही वे उसकी सहायता करेंगे।

ru.L: Бог посреди него; не поколеблется он; поможет ему Бог при наступлении утра.
ru.B: Бог — посреди города; ничто его не опрокинет. Бог придёт ему на помощь с рассветом.
ru.R: Бог там, прямо в городе, поэтому ничто не может его разрушить. Он поможет ему, как только наступит утро.

ja.L: 神がその[都の]中におられる。都は揺るがない。神は、朝が明けるころ、都を助けられる。
ja.B: 神が都の真ん中におられる。都がよろめくことはない。夜が明けるとき、神は都を助けてくださる。
ja.R: 神が、その都の中におられる。だから、何ものも都を倒すことはできない。朝が来ると、すぐに神は都を助けてくださる。

uk.L: Бог — посеред нього; воно не похитнеться; Бог допоможе йому на світанку.
uk.B: Бог — посеред міста; ніщо його не повалить. Бог прийде йому на допомогу, щойно розвидниться.
uk.R: Бог — тут, у місті, тож ніщо не може його зруйнувати. Він допоможе йому, щойно настане ранок.

decisions.choice: at the turning of morning: at dawn
decisions.reason: Help at dawn is help after a night of danger. Israel was rescued at the Red Sea as the morning came (Exodus 14:27), and the army that besieged Jerusalem was found dead in the morning (Isaiah 37:36).

decisions.choice: shaken: made to totter
decisions.reason: The verb (mot) is the one used of the mountains in verse 3. The mountains may totter, but the city where God lives will not.

decisions.choice: it (the city)
decisions.reason: In the Hebrew a city is feminine, "she". Balanced and Readable say "the city" and "it"; Literal keeps "her".

decisions.choice: "elle" for the city at every level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew speaks of the city as "she", and French "la ville" is feminine too, so French keeps "elle" at every level; the English Balanced and Readable have to say "it".

decisions.choice: "thành" (the city) for "her"; "lúc rạng đông" for "at the turning of morning"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese does not call a city "she", so Literal names the city, as the English Balanced does; "rạng đông" (dawn) is the plain sense of the idiom (see the meaning decision).

decisions.choice: नगरी, feminine (L); नगर (B, R)
decisions.reason: In the Hebrew a city is feminine, "she". Literal keeps that with नगरी, a feminine word for city, and feminine verbs (डगमगाएगी); Balanced and Readable say नगर, as the English says "the city" and "it". The same holds for Zion in Psalm 48.

decisions.choice: "него", "он", "ему" for the city
decisions.reason: The Hebrew city is feminine and the English Literal keeps "her"; Russian "город" is masculine, so the pronouns follow it at every level.

decisions.choice: bal-timmot "揺るがない" (L), "よろめくことはない" (B), "倒すことはできない" (R); lifnot boqer "朝が明けるころ" (L), "夜が明けるとき" (B)
decisions.reason: mot (niphal) by PSA-2 (15:5); at dawn (m1).

source.text: הָמ֣וּ ג֭וֹיִםמָ֣טוּ מַמְלָכ֑וֹת נָתַ֥ן בְּ֝קוֹל֗וֹ תָּמ֥וּג אָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: Nations were in uproar, kingdoms tottered; he gave forth his voice, [the] earth melts.

en.L: Nations were in uproar, kingdoms tottered; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave forth {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice, [the] earth melts.
en.B: Nations were in turmoil and kingdoms shook; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} thundered, and the earth melted away.
en.R: Nations were in an uproar. Kingdoms were falling. Then God shouted like thunder, and the earth melted.

fr.L: Des nations ont grondé, des royaumes ont chancelé ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait entendre {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voix, la terre fond.
fr.B: Les nations étaient en tumulte et les royaumes vacillaient ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a tonné, et la terre s’est fondue.
fr.R: Les nations étaient en colère. Les royaumes tombaient. Alors Dieu a crié comme le tonnerre, et la terre a fondu.

sw.L: Mataifa yalighadhibika, falme ziliyumba; {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} alitoa sauti {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, dunia inayeyuka.
sw.B: Mataifa yalichafuka na falme zikatikisika; {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} alinguruma, na dunia ikayeyuka.
sw.R: Mataifa yalikuwa na ghasia. Falme zilikuwa zikianguka. Ndipo Mungu alipopiga kelele kama radi, na dunia ikayeyuka.

es.L: Las naciones se alborotaron, los reinos se tambalearon; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dio {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voz, [la] tierra se derrite.
es.B: Las naciones se agitaron y los reinos temblaron; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} tronó, y la tierra se derritió.
es.R: Las naciones estaban alborotadas. Los reinos se venían abajo. Entonces Dios gritó como un trueno, y la tierra se derritió.

vi.L: Các nước náo động, các vương quốc lung lay; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phát tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra, đất tan chảy.
vi.B: Các nước náo loạn và các vương quốc rung chuyển; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phát tiếng như sấm, và đất liền tan chảy.
vi.R: Các nước náo động. Các vương quốc sụp đổ. Rồi Đức Chúa Trời lớn tiếng như sấm, và đất tan chảy.

ko.L: 민족들이 소동하고 왕국들이 흔들렸다. 그분께서 그분의 소리를 내시니 땅이 녹는다.
ko.B: 민족들이 술렁이고 왕국들이 흔들렸다. 그분께서 우레같이 소리치시니 땅이 녹아내렸다.
ko.R: 민족들이 소란을 피우고 나라들이 무너졌다. 그때 하나님께서 천둥처럼 외치시니 땅이 녹아 버렸다.

pt.L: Nações se agitaram, reinos vacilaram; {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} soltou a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} voz, [a] terra se derrete.
pt.B: As nações se alvoroçaram e os reinos tremeram; {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} trovejou, e a terra se derreteu.
pt.R: As nações estavam em alvoroço. Reinos estavam caindo. Então Deus gritou como um trovão, e a terra se derreteu.

am.L: ሕዝቦች ታወኩ፤ መንግሥታት ተናወጡ፤ ድምፁን አሰማ፤ ምድር ትቀልጣለች።
am.B: ሕዝቦች ተሸበሩ፤ መንግሥታትም ተናወጡ፤ እርሱ አንጎደጎደ፤ ምድርም ቀለጠች።
am.R: ሕዝቦች ታወኩ። መንግሥታት ወደቁ። ከዚያም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ነጎድጓድ ጮኸ፤ ምድርም ቀለጠች።

hi.L: जातियाँ हुल्लड़ करती थीं, राज्य डगमगाते थे; उन्होंने अपना शब्द सुनाया, पृथ्वी पिघल जाती है।
hi.B: राष्ट्रों में खलबली मची और राज्य डगमगा गए; वे गरजे, और पृथ्वी पिघल गई।
hi.R: राष्ट्रों में हलचल मची हुई थी। राज्य गिर रहे थे। तब परमेश्वर ने बादल की गर्जन जैसी आवाज़ में पुकारा, और पृथ्वी पिघल गई।

ru.L: Взволновались народы, пошатнулись царства; {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} подал свой голос — тает земля.
ru.B: Народы смятены, и царства зашатались; {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} прогремел, и растаяла земля.
ru.R: Народы бушевали. Царства рушились. Тогда Бог закричал, как гром, и земля растаяла.

ja.L: 諸国の民は騒ぎ立ち、もろもろの王国はよろめいた。その方が声を発せられると、地は溶ける。
ja.B: 諸国の民はどよめき、王国は揺らいだ。その方がとどろく声を上げられると、地は溶け去った。
ja.R: 国々は大騒ぎになり、王国は次々と倒れた。そのとき、神が雷のように叫ばれると、地は溶けてしまった。

uk.L: Народи вирували, царства хиталися; {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} подав {{deity_pronoun:свій|Свій}} голос — земля тане.
uk.B: Народи бушували, і царства хиталися; {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} загримів, і земля розтанула.
uk.R: Народи збурилися. Царства падали. Тоді Бог крикнув, як грім, і земля розтанула.

decisions.choice: he gave forth his voice: he thundered
decisions.reason: God's voice is often the thunder (18:14; 29:3). One word from him, and the nations' uproar is over.

decisions.choice: were in uproar, tottered, melts: what happened and what happens
decisions.reason: The first three verbs are past forms and the last is the ongoing form: the psalm looks back at a time the nations rose against Zion (compare 48:5-8), and says what always happens when God speaks. The words "uproar" and "totter" are the ones used of the sea (verse 4) and the mountains (verse 3).

decisions.choice: God
decisions.reason: Readable names who speaks, since the verse does not.

decisions.choice: natan beqolo "声を発せられる" (L), "とどろく声を上げられる" (B), "雷のように叫ばれる" (R); tamug "溶ける" present (L), past (B, R)
decisions.reason: He thundered (m1); Literal keeps the Hebrew's change of tense (m2), Balanced and Readable tell it as past, as the English.

source.text: יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֣וֹת עִמָּ֑נוּ מִשְׂגָּֽב־לָ֝נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH of hosts [is] with us; a high refuge for us [is the] God of Jacob. Selah.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts [is] with us; a high refuge for us [is] the God of Jacob. Selah
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies is on our side; the God of Jacob is our high fortress. Selah
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies stands with us. Jacob's God protects us like a fortress high on a rock. Selah

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées [est] avec nous ; une haute retraite pour nous, [c’est] le Dieu de Jacob. Sélah
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées est à nos côtés ; le Dieu de Jacob est notre forteresse élevée. Sélah
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées est avec nous. Le Dieu de Jacob nous protège comme une forteresse tout en haut d’un rocher. Sélah

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi [yuko] pamoja nasi; ngome ya juu kwetu [ni] Mungu wa Yakobo. Sela
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi yuko upande wetu; Mungu wa Yakobo ndiye ngome yetu ya juu. Sela
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi anasimama pamoja nasi. Mungu wa Yakobo anatulinda kama ngome iliyo juu ya mwamba. Sela

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos [está] con nosotros; un alto refugio para nosotros [es] el Dios de Jacob. Selah
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos está de nuestro lado; el Dios de Jacob es nuestra alta fortaleza. Selah
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos está con nosotros. El Dios de Jacob nos protege como una fortaleza en lo alto de una roca. Selah

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân [ở] với chúng ta; Đức Chúa Trời của Gia-cốp [là] nơi ẩn náu trên cao cho chúng ta. Sê-la
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân ở cùng chúng ta; Đức Chúa Trời của Gia-cốp là đồn lũy trên cao của chúng ta. Sê-la
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đứng về phía chúng ta. Đức Chúa Trời của Gia-cốp bảo vệ chúng ta như một đồn lũy cao trên núi đá. Sê-la

ko.L: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리와 함께 [계시고], 야곱의 하나님은 우리에게 높은 피난처[이시다]. 셀라.
ko.B: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리 편에 계시고, 야곱의 하나님은 우리의 높은 요새이시다. 셀라.
ko.R: 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리와 함께 계신다. 야곱의 하나님께서 높은 바위 위의 요새처럼 우리를 지켜 주신다. 셀라.

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos [está] conosco; um alto refúgio para nós [é] o Deus de Jacó. Selá
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos está conosco; o Deus de Jacó é a nossa fortaleza. Selá
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos está do nosso lado. O Deus de Jacó nos protege como uma fortaleza no alto de uma rocha. Selá

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት ከእኛ ጋር [ነው]፤ የያዕቆብ አምላክ ለእኛ ከፍ ያለ መጠጊያ [ነው]። ሴላ
am.B: የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከእኛ ጋር ነው፤ የያዕቆብ አምላክ ከፍ ያለ ምሽጋችን ነው። ሴላ

decisions.choice: YHWH of hosts: the LORD who commands armies
decisions.reason: The hosts (tseba'ot) are armies: the armies of heaven, angels and stars, and the army of Israel. Against nations in uproar (verse 7), the LORD of all armies is with his people.

decisions.choice: a high refuge: a stronghold out of reach
decisions.reason: The word (misgav) is a high place where no enemy can reach, as in 9:10.

decisions.choice: with us: the promise behind the name Immanuel
decisions.reason: "God with us" is the promise of Isaiah 7:14 and of Isaiah 8, given in a time when Jerusalem was threatened by enemy kings.

decisions.choice: the LORD of Armies
decisions.reason: The title (YHWH tseba'ot) names the LORD as commander of the armies of heaven, his angels and the stars (1 Kings 22:19; Isaiah 40:26), and of Israel's army (1 Samuel 17:45). Literal keeps the older "hosts"; Balanced and Readable say "Armies", as in Isaiah.

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

decisions.choice: "le SEIGNEUR" in capitals for the divine name, with "Yahvé" as the reader's alternative; "le SEIGNEUR des armées" for YHWH tseba'ot at every level, for this block of psalms
decisions.reason: As in the Pentateuch, capitals mark the name, as the English "the LORD" does; "l'Éternel", the Segond tradition, is the form a reviewer may prefer. The hosts are armies, of heaven and of Israel (meaning decision m1); French "des armées" says that plainly at every level, as the English Balanced and Readable say "of Armies".

decisions.choice: "BWANA wa majeshi" at every level
decisions.reason: The English has "of hosts" at Literal and "of Armies" at Balanced and Readable; the Swahili "majeshi" (armies, hosts) says both, so one wording serves every level.

decisions.choice: de los ejércitos (L); de los Ejércitos (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew title (YHWH tseva'ot) names the LORD as the one who commands armies. Spanish "ejércitos" says both the English Literal "hosts" and the Balanced and Readable "Armies"; Literal keeps it lowercase like an ordinary noun, Balanced and Readable capitalise it as part of the title, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "CHÚA Vạn Quân" and "Đức Chúa Trời Vạn Quân" at every level, as James 5:4
decisions.reason: The title names the LORD as commander of armies (see the meaning decision). "vạn quân" (of countless armies) is the short form Vietnamese readers know, used at Romans 9:29 (Balanced); Readable says it in plain words.

decisions.choice: "만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}" (L, B) and "하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}" (R) for YHWH of hosts
decisions.reason: The title says the LORD who commands armies (meaning decision m1). "만군" (all the hosts) is the Korean word for it; Readable spells out what it means, as the English Readable says "Armies". The name is under the divine_name setting, the rest of the title outside it.

decisions.choice: YHWH is {{divine_name:주|야훼}} with the particle outside the span (께서), as in the published psalms
decisions.reason: As the style guide (section 7a): "주" by default, "야훼" as the alternative, as the English has "the LORD|Yahweh"; this holds for the whole block of psalms.

decisions.choice: the refrain of verses 8 and 12, one wording per level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats the refrain word for word in verse 12, so each level repeats its Portuguese. "O SENHOR dos Exércitos" at every level, as the terms of the Old Testament set it; Literal keeps "um alto refúgio" (m2), Balanced says "a nossa fortaleza", Readable the picture of a fortress high on a rock, as the English Readable.

decisions.choice: YHWH of hosts as "{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት" (Literal), "የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}" (Balanced, Readable); the refrain worded the same in verse 12
decisions.reason: The terms list's wording for YHWH Tsevaot; the refrain returns unchanged in verse 12, as in the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} (every level); ऊँचा गढ़
decisions.reason: YHWH of hosts is सेनाओं के प्रभु, as in Romans 9:29 and the history books. The English says "of hosts" at Literal and "of Armies" at Balanced and Readable; Hindi सेना means both, so one form serves every level. The "high refuge" (misgav) is ऊँचा गढ़, a stronghold out of reach, kept apart from शरणस्थान (refuge, verse 2). The refrain (verses 8 and 12) has one wording per level.

decisions.choice: "ГОСПОДЬ Саваоф" (L, B); "ГОСПОДЬ Воинств" (R)
decisions.reason: The history note's forms for YHWH of hosts: Literal and Balanced keep "Саваоф", as Romans 9:29 does in this translation; Readable says "Воинств", the LORD who commands armies (m1), as the English says "of Armies".

decisions.choice: YHWH tseva'ot "万軍のDN" (L, B), "天の軍勢を率いるDN" (R); misgav "高い砦" (L, B), "岩の上の高いとりで" (R); the refrain the same in 46:12
decisions.reason: The Psalter's forms (PSA-1); a stronghold out of reach (m2).

records.literal_gloss: Come, see [the] works of YHWH, who has set desolations on the earth.

en.L: Come, see the works of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who has set desolations on the earth.
en.B: Come, look at the deeds of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the havoc {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has worked across the earth.
en.R: Come and look at the things {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has done. He has left ruins all over the earth.

fr.L: Venez, voyez les œuvres {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qui a mis des ravages sur la terre.
fr.B: Venez, regardez les actes {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, les ravages qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a causés sur la terre.
fr.R: Venez voir ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait. Il a laissé des ruines partout sur la terre.

sw.L: Njooni, mtazame kazi za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ambaye ameweka uharibifu juu ya nchi.
sw.B: Njooni, angalieni matendo ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, maangamizi aliyoyaleta katika dunia yote.
sw.R: Njooni mtazame mambo ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amefanya. Ameacha magofu kila mahali duniani.

es.L: {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, {{plural_you:vean|ved}} las obras {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, que ha puesto desolaciones en la tierra.
es.B: {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, {{plural_you:miren|mirad}} las hazañas {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, los estragos que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho por toda la tierra.
es.R: {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}} a ver lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hecho. Ha dejado ruinas por toda la tierra.

vi.L: Hãy đến, xem các công việc của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng đã đặt những cảnh hoang tàn trên đất.
vi.B: Hãy đến, hãy nhìn xem những việc {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm, những cảnh tàn phá {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã gây ra khắp mặt đất.
vi.R: Hãy đến xem những việc {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm. Ngài đã để lại những đống đổ nát khắp mặt đất.

ko.L: 와서, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 일들을 보아라, 그분께서 땅에 황폐함을 이루셨다.
ko.B: 와서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하신 일들을 보아라. 그분께서 온 땅을 폐허로 만드셨다.
ko.R: 와서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하신 일들을 보아라. 그분께서 온 땅에 무너진 터만 남기셨다.

pt.L: Venham, vejam as obras {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, que pôs desolações na terra.
pt.B: Venham, observem os feitos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, a destruição que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} causou por toda a terra.
pt.R: Venham ver as coisas que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fez. Ele deixou ruínas por toda a terra.

am.L: ኑ፣ በምድር ላይ ባድማን ያደረገውን {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ሥራ እዩ።
am.B: ኑ፣ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ሥራ ተመልከቱ፤ በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ያደረሰውን ጥፋት እዩ።
am.R: ኑና {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ያደረገውን ተመልከቱ። በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ፍርስራሽ ትቶአል።

hi.L: आओ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के कामों को देखो, जिन्होंने पृथ्वी पर उजाड़ कर दिए हैं।
hi.B: आओ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के कामों को देखो, कि उन्होंने सारी पृथ्वी पर कैसा विनाश किया है।
hi.R: आओ और देखो कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने क्या-क्या किया है। उन्होंने सारी पृथ्वी पर खंडहर छोड़ दिए हैं।

ru.L: Придите, посмотрите на дела {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, который произвёл опустошения на земле.
ru.B: Придите, взгляните на дела {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, на разрушения, которые {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} совершил по всей земле.
ru.R: Придите и посмотрите, что сделал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Он оставил развалины по всей земле.

ja.L: 来て、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のみわざを見よ。その方は、地に荒廃を置かれた。
ja.B: 来て、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のみわざを見なさい。その方は、地の上に荒れ果てたさまをもたらされた。
ja.R: 来て、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がなさったことを見なさい。その方は、地上のあちこちを廃墟にされた。

uk.L: Ідіть, подивіться на діла {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, який учинив спустошення на землі.
uk.B: Ідіть, подивіться на діла {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, на руйнування, які {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} учинив по всій землі.
uk.R: Ідіть і подивіться, що зробив {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Він залишив руїни по всій землі.

decisions.choice: desolations: ruins, things that appall
decisions.reason: The word (shammot) means ruins, and also the horror or astonishment they cause. Verse 10 shows what is ruined: the weapons of war. The ancient Greek translation has "wonders".

decisions.choice: Come, see: an invitation to all
decisions.reason: The commands are plural: everyone is invited to come and look at what God has done to the armies that came against his city.

decisions.choice: Venham (vocês)
decisions.reason: The commands are plural, an invitation to everyone (m2), so Portuguese uses the plural "vocês" form, the living plural of address.

decisions.choice: lekhu-chazu "来て、…見よ" (L), "見なさい" (B, R); shammot "荒廃" (L), "荒れ果てたさま" (B), "廃墟" (R)
decisions.reason: An invitation to all (m2), in the forms for the psalmist's commands to people (PSA-1); "見よ" here is the verb "see", not hinneh. Desolations (m1, uncertain).

source.text: מַשְׁבִּ֥ית מִלְחָמוֹת֮ עַד־קְצֵ֪ה הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ קֶ֣שֶׁת יְ֭שַׁבֵּר וְקִצֵּ֣ץ חֲנִ֑ית עֲ֝גָל֗וֹת יִשְׂרֹ֥ף בָּאֵֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: Making wars cease to [the] end of the earth; bow he breaks and cuts in two spear; carts he burns with fire.

en.L: [He is] making wars cease to the end of the earth; [the] bow {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} breaks and cuts [the] spear in two; carts {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} burns with fire.
en.B: He puts an end to wars as far as the earth reaches; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} snaps the bow, splits the spear, and sets the war wagons on fire.
en.R: He stops wars all over the world. He breaks bows, snaps spears in two, and burns up the war wagons.

fr.L: [Il] fait cesser les guerres jusqu’au bout de la terre ; l’arc, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} [le] brise, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} coupe la lance en deux ; les chariots, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} [les] brûle au feu.
fr.B: Il met fin aux guerres jusqu’aux extrémités de la terre ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} rompt l’arc, fend la lance et livre au feu les chariots de guerre.
fr.R: Il arrête les guerres dans le monde entier. Il casse les arcs, brise les lances en deux et brûle les chariots de guerre.

sw.L: [Anayekomesha] vita mpaka mwisho wa dunia; upinde {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anauvunja, na mkuki anaukata vipande viwili; magari {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anayachoma kwa moto.
sw.B: Anakomesha vita mpaka miisho ya dunia; anavunja upinde, anakata mkuki, na kuyachoma moto magari ya vita.
sw.R: Anakomesha vita duniani kote. Anavunja pinde, anakata mikuki vipande viwili, na kuchoma magari ya vita.

es.L: [Él está] haciendo cesar las guerras hasta el fin de la tierra; quiebra [el] arco y parte en dos [la] lanza; las carretas las quema en el fuego.
es.B: Él pone fin a las guerras hasta los confines de la tierra; quiebra el arco, parte la lanza y prende fuego a los carros de guerra.
es.R: Él detiene las guerras en todo el mundo. Rompe los arcos, parte en dos las lanzas y quema los carros de guerra.

vi.L: [Ngài] làm cho chiến tranh dứt đến tận cùng trái đất; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bẻ gãy cung và chặt giáo làm đôi; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đốt các xe bằng lửa.
vi.B: Ngài chấm dứt chiến tranh đến tận cùng trái đất; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bẻ gãy cây cung, chặt đứt cây giáo, và đốt cháy các xe chiến.
vi.R: Ngài chấm dứt chiến tranh trên khắp thế giới. Ngài bẻ gãy cung, bẻ giáo làm đôi, và đốt cháy các xe chiến.

ko.L: 땅끝까지 전쟁들을 그치게 하시고, 활을 꺾으시며 창을 부러뜨리시고, 수레들을 불로 사르신다.
ko.B: 그분께서 땅끝까지 전쟁을 그치게 하신다. 활을 꺾으시고 창을 부러뜨리시며 전차들을 불사르신다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 온 세상에서 전쟁을 멈추게 하신다. 활을 꺾으시고, 창을 두 동강 내시고, 전쟁 수레들을 불태우신다.

pt.L: [Ele está] fazendo cessar as guerras até o fim da terra; [o] arco {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} quebra e corta [a] lança em dois; as carroças {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} queima no fogo.
pt.B: Ele põe fim às guerras até os confins da terra; {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} parte o arco, racha a lança e põe fogo nas carroças de guerra.
pt.R: Ele acaba com as guerras no mundo inteiro. Ele quebra os arcos, parte as lanças ao meio e queima as carroças de guerra.

am.L: [እርሱ] እስከ ምድር ዳርቻ ጦርነትን ያስቆማል፤ ቀስትን ይሰብራል፤ ጦርንም ይቆርጣል፤ ጋሪዎችን በእሳት ያቃጥላል።
am.B: እስከ ምድር ዳርቻ ድረስ ጦርነትን ያስቀራል፤ ቀስትን ይሰብራል፤ ጦርንም ይከፍላል፤ የጦር ጋሪዎችንም በእሳት ያቃጥላል።
am.R: በዓለም ሁሉ ጦርነትን ያስቆማል። ቀስቶችን ይሰብራል፤ ጦሮችን ለሁለት ይቆርጣል፤ የጦር ጋሪዎችንም ያቃጥላል።

hi.L: [वे] पृथ्वी की छोर तक युद्धों को मिटाते हैं; वे धनुष को तोड़ते और भाले को दो टुकड़े कर देते हैं; गाड़ियों को वे आग में जला देते हैं।
hi.B: वे पृथ्वी के छोर तक युद्धों का अंत कर देते हैं; वे धनुष को तोड़ डालते, भाले को चीर देते, और युद्ध की गाड़ियों को आग लगा देते हैं।
hi.R: वे सारे संसार में युद्ध रोक देते हैं। वे धनुषों को तोड़ देते हैं, भालों के दो टुकड़े कर देते हैं, और युद्ध की गाड़ियों को जला देते हैं।

ru.L: [Он] прекращает войны до края земли; лук {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} ломает и копьё рассекает; повозки {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сжигает огнём.
ru.B: Он прекращает войны до краёв земли; {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} ломает лук, раскалывает копьё и сжигает боевые повозки.
ru.R: Он останавливает войны по всему миру. Он ломает луки, раскалывает копья и сжигает военные повозки.

ja.L: [その方は]地の果てまで戦いをやめさせ、弓を折り、槍を断ち切り、車を火で焼かれる。
ja.B: その方は地の果てまで戦いを終わらせ、弓を砕き、槍を断ち切り、戦いの車を火で焼かれる。
ja.R: その方は、世界中の戦争をやめさせる。弓を折り、やりを二つに折り、戦いの車を焼きつくされる。

uk.L: [Він] припиняє війни аж до краю землі; лук {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} ламає і списа перерубує; вози {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} палить вогнем.
uk.B: Він кладе край війнам, аж куди сягає земля; {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} ламає лук, розщеплює спис і підпалює бойові вози.
uk.R: Він зупиняє війни по всьому світу. Він ламає луки, розламує навпіл списи й спалює бойові вози.

decisions.choice: carts: wagons, here wagons of war
decisions.reason: The word ('agalot) means wagons or carts; here they are an army's carts, burned with the rest of its gear. The ancient Greek translation, with a different vowel reading, has "shields".

decisions.choice: making wars cease: God disarms the world
decisions.reason: God's victory ends in peace, not more war: the weapons are destroyed, as in Isaiah 2:4 and Hosea 2 (compare 76:4).

decisions.choice: making: the deeds of verse 9 go on
decisions.reason: The verse begins with a participle that continues "who has set desolations" in verse 9.

decisions.choice: 'agalot "車" (L), "戦いの車" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Wagons, here read as wagons of war (m1, uncertain, footnoted), kept apart from rekhev 戦車.

source.text: הַרְפּ֣וּ וּ֭דְעוּ כִּי־אָנֹכִ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָר֥וּם בַּ֝גּוֹיִ֗ם אָר֥וּם בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: Let go and know that I [am] God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.

en.L: "Be still, and know that I [am] God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth."
en.B: "Stop, and acknowledge that I am God. Among the nations I will be lifted high; over all the earth I will be lifted high."
en.R: "Stop fighting, and know that I am God! All the nations will honor {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. Everyone on earth will honor {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."

fr.L: « Arrêtez, et sachez que je [suis] Dieu ; je serai exalté parmi les nations, je serai exalté sur la terre. »
fr.B: « Cessez, et reconnaissez que je suis Dieu. Parmi les nations je serai élevé ; sur toute la terre je serai élevé. »
fr.R: « Arrêtez de vous battre, et sachez que je suis Dieu ! Toutes les nations {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}honoreront. Tout le monde sur la terre {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}honorera. »

sw.L: "Tulieni, mkatambue kwamba mimi [ni] Mungu; nitakwezwa kati ya mataifa, nitakwezwa katika dunia."
sw.B: "Komeni, mkiri kwamba mimi ni Mungu. Kati ya mataifa nitainuliwa juu; katika dunia yote nitainuliwa juu."
sw.R: "Komeni kupigana, mtambue kuwa mimi ndimi Mungu! Mataifa yote yataniheshimu {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}. Kila mtu duniani ataniheshimu {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}."

es.L: «{{plural_you:Quédense|Quedaos}} quietos, y {{plural_you:sepan|sabed}} que yo [soy] Dios; seré exaltado entre las naciones, seré exaltado en la tierra.»
es.B: «¡{{plural_you:Deténganse|Deteneos}}, y {{plural_you:reconozcan|reconoced}} que yo soy Dios! Entre las naciones seré enaltecido; sobre toda la tierra seré enaltecido.»
es.R: «¡{{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} de pelear, y {{plural_you:sepan|sabed}} que yo soy Dios! Todas las naciones {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} honrarán. Todos en la tierra {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} honrarán.»

vi.L: “Hãy dừng lại, và biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [là] Đức Chúa Trời; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ được tôn cao giữa các dân tộc, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ được tôn cao trên đất.”
vi.B: “Hãy ngừng lại, và nhận biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Đức Chúa Trời. Giữa các dân tộc, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ được tôn cao; trên khắp đất, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ được tôn cao.”
vi.R: “Hãy ngừng chiến đấu, và biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Đức Chúa Trời! Mọi dân tộc sẽ tôn kính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Mọi người trên đất sẽ tôn kính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.”

ko.L: “가만히 있어라, 그리고 내가 하나님임을 알아라. 내가 민족들 가운데서 높임을 받고, 내가 땅에서 높임을 받을 것이다.”
ko.B: “멈추어라. 그리고 내가 하나님인 줄 알아라. 내가 민족들 가운데서 높임을 받고, 온 땅에서 높임을 받을 것이다.”
ko.R: “싸움을 멈추어라. 내가 하나님인 줄 알아라! 모든 민족이 나를 높일 것이다. 땅 위의 모든 사람이 나를 높일 것이다.”

pt.L: "Aquietem-se, e reconheçam que eu [sou] Deus; serei exaltado entre as nações, serei exaltado sobre a terra."
pt.B: "Parem, e reconheçam que eu sou Deus. Entre as nações serei erguido bem alto; sobre toda a terra serei erguido bem alto."
pt.R: "Parem de brigar e saibam que eu sou Deus! Todas as nações vão {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} honrar. Todos na terra vão {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} honrar."

am.L: «ጸጥ በሉ፤ እኔ አምላክ እንደ ሆንኩ እወቁ፤ በሕዝቦች መካከል ከፍ ከፍ እላለሁ፤ በምድር ላይ ከፍ ከፍ እላለሁ።»
am.B: «ተዉ፤ እኔ አምላክ መሆኔንም እወቁ። በሕዝቦች መካከል ከፍ ከፍ እላለሁ፤ በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ከፍ ከፍ እላለሁ።»
am.R: «መዋጋታችሁን አቁሙ፤ እኔ አምላክ መሆኔንም እወቁ! ሕዝቦች ሁሉ ያከብሩኛል። በምድር ላይ ያለ ሰው ሁሉ ያከብረኛል።»

hi.L: "थम जाओ, और जानो कि मैं परमेश्वर [हूँ]; मैं जातियों के बीच ऊँचा किया जाऊँगा, मैं पृथ्वी पर ऊँचा किया जाऊँगा।"
hi.B: "रुक जाओ, और मान लो कि मैं परमेश्वर हूँ। राष्ट्रों के बीच मैं ऊँचा किया जाऊँगा; सारी पृथ्वी पर मैं ऊँचा किया जाऊँगा।"
hi.R: "लड़ना बंद करो, और जानो कि मैं परमेश्वर हूँ! सब राष्ट्र मेरा आदर करेंगे। पृथ्वी पर हर कोई मेरा आदर करेगा।"

ru.L: «Утихните и знайте, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — Бог; {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} буду превознесён среди народов, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} буду превознесён на земле.»
ru.B: «Перестаньте и признайте, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — Бог. Среди народов {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} буду вознесён; над всей землёй {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} буду вознесён.»
ru.R: «Перестаньте воевать и знайте, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — Бог! Все народы будут чтить {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}. Все на земле будут чтить {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}.»

ja.L: 「手を放し、知りなさい、わたしが神であることを。わたしは諸国の民の中であがめられ、地の上であがめられる。」
ja.B: 「争いをやめて、わたしが神であることを認めなさい。わたしは諸国の民の中で高く上げられ、全地の上で高く上げられる。」
ja.R: 「戦いをやめなさい。そして、わたしが神であることを知りなさい！すべての国がわたしをあがめる。地上のすべての人が、わたしをあがめる。」

uk.L: «Затихніть і пізнайте, що я — Бог; я буду піднесений між народами, я буду піднесений на землі.»
uk.B: «Зупиніться й визнайте, що я — Бог. Між народами я буду високо піднесений; над усією землею я буду високо піднесений.»
uk.R: «Перестаньте воювати й знайте, що я — Бог! Усі народи шануватимуть {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}. Усі на землі шануватимуть {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}.»

decisions.choice: God speaks
decisions.reason: Without any introduction, God himself speaks. He answers the nations' uproar (verse 7) with a command and a promise, so the words are set in quotation marks.

decisions.choice: Let go: stop, leave off
decisions.reason: The verb (rafah, causative) means to let the hands drop, to stop doing something (Judges 8:3; 1 Samuel 15:16). After verses 9-10 it is a command to the warring nations to put down their weapons, and also a call to God's people to stop striving and trust him.

decisions.choice: I will be exalted: I will be lifted high, honored by all
decisions.reason: The verb (rum) means to be high. The nations that rose up will see God as the one who is high over them.

decisions.choice: Be still
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the familiar "Be still", which can bear the sense "stop" (m2).

decisions.choice: All the nations will honor me
decisions.reason: Readable says what being exalted among the nations means (m3).

decisions.choice: "Arrêtez" at Literal
decisions.reason: The verb means to let the hands drop and stop (meaning decision m2). The English Literal keeps the familiar "Be still"; French has no phrase that is both familiar and as open, so Literal says "Arrêtez", which keeps the sense of a command to the warring nations.

decisions.choice: plural_you setting on God's commands to the nations
decisions.reason: God speaks to many people here (the verbs are plural), so the commands carry the plural_you setting: "ustedes" forms by default and "vosotros" forms as the alternative.

decisions.choice: "Ta" for God speaking
decisions.reason: God speaks in this verse (see the meaning decision); Vietnamese gives him "Ta", the first person of a sovereign, as the style guide does for God speaking.

decisions.choice: God speaks in 해라체 with "나" (가만히 있어라, 내가)
decisions.reason: Style guide section 7a: God speaking uses 해라체 with 나; the quotation marks show the change of speaker (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: Aquietem-se
decisions.reason: The verb is to let the hands drop, to stop (m2). Literal says "Aquietem-se", the counterpart of the English Literal's familiar "Be still", which can bear the sense "stop"; Balanced and Readable say "Parem". God speaks to the nations and his people together, so the plural "vocês" forms.

decisions.choice: "Let go" as "ጸጥ በሉ" (Literal, as the English "Be still"), "ተዉ" (Balanced, stop), "መዋጋታችሁን አቁሙ" (Readable); "I am God" with "አምላክ"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the verb as a command to the warring nations to stop; Balanced and Readable say that. Elohim is the predicate here ("that I am God"), where Amharic says "አምላክ".

decisions.choice: थम जाओ (L); रुक जाओ (B); लड़ना बंद करो (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means let go, stop, leave off. God speaks to the warring nations (plural, तुम-forms). Literal says थम जाओ, which, like the English "be still", can mean "stop"; Balanced says रुक जाओ and Readable लड़ना बंद करो, as the English says "stop" and "stop fighting". God speaking uses मैं.

decisions.choice: "Утихните" (L); "Перестаньте" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb means let go, stop (m2). Literal keeps a word that can also mean "be still", as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable say "stop".

decisions.choice: "я" with a deity_pronoun span mid-sentence
decisions.reason: God speaks (m1); a mid-sentence "я" for God takes the span, as "меня" does, so that the two are capitalised together.

decisions.choice: God speaks plainly with 〜なさい (L, B, R); harpu "手を放し" (L), "争いをやめて" (B), "戦いをやめなさい" (R)
decisions.reason: God's speech in the Psalter is plain with commands in 〜なさい (PSA-1); "let go" is stop, leave off (m2), worded afresh rather than in the familiar church forms of this verse.

source.text: יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֣וֹת עִמָּ֑נוּ מִשְׂגָּֽב־לָ֝נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH of hosts [is] with us; a high refuge for us [is the] God of Jacob. Selah.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts [is] with us; a high refuge for us [is] the God of Jacob. Selah
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies is on our side; the God of Jacob is our high fortress. Selah
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies stands with us. Jacob's God protects us like a fortress high on a rock. Selah

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées [est] avec nous ; une haute retraite pour nous, [c’est] le Dieu de Jacob. Sélah
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées est à nos côtés ; le Dieu de Jacob est notre forteresse élevée. Sélah
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées est avec nous. Le Dieu de Jacob nous protège comme une forteresse tout en haut d’un rocher. Sélah

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi [yuko] pamoja nasi; ngome ya juu kwetu [ni] Mungu wa Yakobo. Sela
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi yuko upande wetu; Mungu wa Yakobo ndiye ngome yetu ya juu. Sela
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi anasimama pamoja nasi. Mungu wa Yakobo anatulinda kama ngome iliyo juu ya mwamba. Sela

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos [está] con nosotros; un alto refugio para nosotros [es] el Dios de Jacob. Selah
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos está de nuestro lado; el Dios de Jacob es nuestra alta fortaleza. Selah
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos está con nosotros. El Dios de Jacob nos protege como una fortaleza en lo alto de una roca. Selah

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân [ở] với chúng ta; Đức Chúa Trời của Gia-cốp [là] nơi ẩn náu trên cao cho chúng ta. Sê-la
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân ở cùng chúng ta; Đức Chúa Trời của Gia-cốp là đồn lũy trên cao của chúng ta. Sê-la
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đứng về phía chúng ta. Đức Chúa Trời của Gia-cốp bảo vệ chúng ta như một đồn lũy cao trên núi đá. Sê-la

ko.L: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리와 함께 [계시고], 야곱의 하나님은 우리에게 높은 피난처[이시다]. 셀라.
ko.B: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리 편에 계시고, 야곱의 하나님은 우리의 높은 요새이시다. 셀라.
ko.R: 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리와 함께 계신다. 야곱의 하나님께서 높은 바위 위의 요새처럼 우리를 지켜 주신다. 셀라.

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos [está] conosco; um alto refúgio para nós [é] o Deus de Jacó. Selá
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos está conosco; o Deus de Jacó é a nossa fortaleza. Selá

decisions.choice: the LORD of Armies
decisions.reason: The title (YHWH tseba'ot) names the LORD as commander of the armies of heaven, his angels and the stars (1 Kings 22:19; Isaiah 40:26), and of Israel's army (1 Samuel 17:45). Literal keeps the older "hosts"; Balanced and Readable say "Armies", as in Isaiah.

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

decisions.choice: the refrain as in verse 8
decisions.reason: The refrain repeats verse 8 word for word in the Hebrew, so each level keeps the wording of verse 8.
